coverage.evidence: CharityCampaignHelpers.cs:18-43 registers charity.name, link, raised, target, percent and bar; CharityDonationHelpers.cs:21-29 registers charity.donations.count and charity.donations.latest; LiveCharityRows.cs:33 and :50 print a value only when call.Args.Count == 0, so no form takes an argument.

LiveText.cs:60-67 formats Money as symbol plus N<decimalPlaces> in the channel culture, or the code after the amount for an unknown currency; LiveText.cs:36-37 returns null for Percent when the target is 0 or less, and MusicText.cs:47 rounds it to a whole number with no clamp; LiveText.cs:40-50 and MeterBars.cs:17-30 draw 10 cells clamped to 0..100, rounded away from zero, followed by the percent; CharityCampaignHelpers.cs:22 returns null for a blank website; NumberCulture.cs:22-34 falls back to en-US when no language is set.

LiveEventRow.cs:44-45 gives every charity row TemplateHelperContexts.Standard; TemplateHelperContexts.cs:21-22 builds Standard as every context except Viewer (Command, EventResponse, Timer, Pipeline, Discord and Webhook in TemplateHelperContext.cs).

LiveCharityData.cs:57-63 calls GetCharityCampaignAsync and returns null when the call fails; TwitchCharityApi.cs:32-55 reads Helix charity/campaigns after checking for channel:read:charity; LiveCharityData.cs:38-49 keeps one data object per render, so each reply asks Twitch again, and TwitchHelixTransport has no cache.

CharityDonationHelpers.cs:21 shows Math.Max(page.Total, page.Items.Count) and :26-29 return null for an empty page, otherwise 'UserName (Money)' of Items[0]; TwitchPage.cs:15 sets PageSize = 100 and TwitchPage.cs:19-21 sets Total to 0 when the endpoint omits it, so the count stops at 100.

TemplateTreeRenderer.cs:19-20 prints a token as written when the evaluator returns null; LiveCharityRows.cs:33-35 and :50-52 return null when there is no campaign or no data; LiveEventHelperProvider RenderAsync returns null without a channel.

reader_answers.evidence: The eight forms match CharityCampaignHelpers.cs:18-43 and CharityDonationHelpers.cs:21-29, and 'no helper takes an argument' matches LiveCharityRows.cs:33 and :50.

TwitchCharityApi.cs:38 and :64 require channel:read:charity; TwitchLoginScopes.cs Broadcaster (user:read:chat, user:write:chat, user:read:moderated_channels) leaves it out; the regrant runs at TwitchDiagnosticsController.cs [HttpPost("regrant")] from MissingTwitchScopesNotice.vue on Settings > Integrations; AuthService.cs:765-801 sets up the session on the approving account's tokens.

The three causes come from LiveCharityData.cs:62 (null on a failed call, which covers a missing scope, no campaign or no answer); TwitchGrantGapSource.cs:144-151 builds the Needs attention item titled 'Twitch permission missing: {scope}'; en.json:49 has 'Permissions granted. Twitch now lets the bot use them.'

With no campaign, CampaignAsync is null and LiveCharityRows.cs:33-35 prints the token as typed; with an empty donation page, CharityDonationHelpers.cs:27 returns null for latest; create-a-command.mdx:139-144 documents the row switch and the Enabled switch.
